reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000658 (the melody read from 000658a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 4 notes off in 34); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Johann Hermann Schein has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1628, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). Johann Sebastian Bach's dates (1685–1750) are from our page for the tune POTSDAM (content/hymns/tunes/potsdam.json); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000658a.nwc).
